A scholar graduate with a degree in Business Management. Jayson is a curious explorer at heart and happiest when surrounded by mountain trails, new flavors and unfamiliar streets waiting to be discovered. With a deep love for hiking, he finds joy in the rhythm of footsteps on winding paths and the quiet reward of breathtaking summit views. Nature is both a playground and a place of reflection.

He has 6 years of work experience in the Insurance Industry working as a Virtual Assistant from the Philippines handling Personal Lines New Business, Remarkets, Claims and Data Entry. Driven by the belief that knowledge empowers and transforms, Jayson continues to seek new learnings that enrich both personal and professional journeys.
